bio: Greenbrix Capital Inc. is an Ontario brokerage specialising in private mortgages, with institutional and B-side options for residential, commercial, gas station, manufacturing, construction, mixed-use, land and multi-unit rental properties. Krystian Catala is President and Mortgage Broker (M12001607), working on private lending, commercial, construction and development financing. The site calls Greenbrix an independently owned franchise of the Dominion Lending Centres network (FSRA licence #13645).
tagline: Mortgage financing for homes, businesses & complex properties.
